name: causal decoder keeps earlier logits fixed
test:
import torch
torch.manual_seed(4)
model = TinyCausalLM(19, 8, 6).eval()
x = torch.tensor([[1, 2, 3, 4]])
y = x.clone(); y[0, 3] = 9
a = model(x); b = model(y)
assert a.shape == (1, 4, 19) and torch.isfinite(a).all()
assert torch.allclose(a[:, :3], b[:, :3], atol=1e-5)

name: classifier ignores invalid token content
test:
import torch
torch.manual_seed(5)
lm = TinyCausalLM(23, 8, 6).eval()
classifier = SequenceClassifier(lm, 3).eval()
x = torch.tensor([[2, 5, 7, 11]])
changed = x.clone(); changed[0, 3] = 17
mask = torch.tensor([[True, True, True, False]])
assert classifier(x, mask).shape == (1, 3)
assert torch.allclose(classifier(x, mask), classifier(changed, mask), atol=1e-5)

name: incremental and full greedy routes agree
test:
import torch
torch.manual_seed(8)
model = TinyCausalLM(13, 8, 7).eval()
prompt = torch.tensor([[1, 2]])
a = greedy_generate(model, prompt, 3, use_cache=False)
b = greedy_generate(model, prompt, 3, use_cache=True)
assert a.shape == (1, 5)
assert torch.equal(a, b)
assert torch.equal(a[:, :2], prompt)

name: greedy generation follows each row's argmax and preserves the prompt
test:
import torch
from torch import nn
class NextTokenOracle(nn.Module):
    def forward(self, token_ids):
        logits = torch.full((*token_ids.shape, 7), -10.0, device=token_ids.device)
        return logits.scatter(-1, ((token_ids + 1) % 7).unsqueeze(-1), 10.0)
prompt = torch.tensor([[1, 2], [4, 5]])
before = prompt.clone()
actual = greedy_generate(NextTokenOracle(), prompt, 3, use_cache=False)
expected = torch.tensor([[1, 2, 3, 4, 5], [4, 5, 6, 0, 1]])
assert torch.equal(actual, expected)
assert torch.equal(prompt, before)
assert torch.equal(greedy_generate(NextTokenOracle(), prompt, 0, use_cache=False), prompt)

name: positions may exceed vocabulary size and decoder gradients remain connected
test:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
torch.manual_seed(41)
model = TinyCausalLM(5, 8, 7)
x = torch.tensor([[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 0], [4, 3, 2, 1, 0, 4]])
logits = model(x)
assert logits.shape == (2, 6, 5) and torch.isfinite(logits).all()
loss = F.cross_entropy(logits.reshape(-1, 5), x.reshape(-1))
loss.backward()
grads = [p.grad for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad]
assert grads and any(g is not None and bool(g.abs().sum() > 0) for g in grads)
assert all(g is None or bool(torch.isfinite(g).all()) for g in grads)
